The necklace drapes heavily around the neck in multiple loops or a wide band structure. The subject is wearing a maroon/burgundy off-the-shoulder top. The background is a plain, light-colored wall with vertical blinds visible on the right.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/blurring in the finest details of the mesh links where they overlap, potentially indicating minor generation smoothing or focus issues, though it could also be photographic depth-of-field.

The way the heavy mesh sits on the skin looks slightly unnatural; the indentation on the skin is minimal given the apparent weight of the metal, suggesting a slight physics simulation error common in AI images.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of jewelry (mesh/chainmail vs standard chain) and verify class alignment.
To audit the complex topology of the mesh links and ensure no fusion artifacts exist between the metal rings.
To assess overall photorealism, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture anomalies in skin and metal.
To verify the spatial relationship between the necklace and the skin, ensuring proper occlusion and contact shadows.

focus_areas: Integrity of individual mesh links (no fusion/melting)
Realism of metal reflections and specular highlights
Contact shadows and pressure points where necklace meets skin
Boundary sharpness between necklace and background/clothing
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'mesh' structure. AI often struggles with repeating intricate patterns like chainmail, leading to 'melted' links or inconsistent ring sizes. Verify if the topology is physically possible. Also, check if the weight of the necklace is realistically represented by the deformation of the skin underneath.
